</details>

| ID | Priority | Topic | Code location | What I noticed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F001 | high | aggregation identity | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:269` | The configuration fingerprint omits `max_iterations`, so different agent budgets can share one aggregate. |
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F002 | high | transcript linkage | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:525` | Consecutive model commands overwrite the one pending-call slot. Results detach from original calls and duplicate executions appear. |
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F004 | medium | workflow identity | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:97` | Unknown workflow labels can normalize to the same evaluation identity. (inline) |
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F005 | medium | attempt selection | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:306` | `best` selects the latest final tie, while `latest` means latest usable attempt rather than latest source attempt. (inline) |
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F006 | medium | source accounting | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:713` | Startup rows can disappear before selection, and all-startup groups can count one source row twice. (inline) |
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F007 | medium | group processing | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:735` | A missing required timestamp raises outside the expected source-data boundary and stops later valid groups. |
| RAV-RUN2-R1-F008 | medium | output path | `every_eval_ever/adapters/bountybench/adapter.py:822` | Publication replaces an arbitrary requested directory's final component with `bountybench`. (inline) |

## Things to try

<details>
<summary>Suggested next steps (7 items)</summary>

- **[high] aggregation identity** — A canonical identity payload can include `model_config` and the effective iteration budget. Missing and explicit defaults can normalize consistently. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P001`)
- **[high] transcript linkage** — Exact-command FIFO queues can preserve source order and repeated commands. Unmatched executor actions can keep their current separate-call behavior. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P002`)
- **[medium] workflow identity** — Only mapped workflow names can enter evaluation identity. Unknown names can use the normal source-failure path. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P004`)
- **[medium] attempt selection** — Numeric `start_epoch` and explicit policy-specific ordering can match the documented rules. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P005`)
- **[medium] source accounting** — Startup exclusions can derive once from the original group, before attempt ranking. The synthetic group exclusion can disappear. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P006`)
- **[medium] group processing** — Required timestamps can validate during parsing. Only defined source-data errors can use partial-mode continuation. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P007`)
- **[medium] output path** — Write-producing runs can validate that the requested collection directory ends in `bountybench` before staging or reports. (`RAV-RUN2-R1-P008`)

**Scope:** This PR adds a WILD-raw aggregate and optional item-level adapter.

## What I noticed

- **RAV-RUN2-R1-F001 [high] instance-publication** `utils/wild/adapter.py:528` — Instance mode passes a sidecar basename where the schema requires a canonical datastore path. Construction fails after aggregate and sidecar files are written. (inline)
- **RAV-RUN2-R1-F002 [medium] documentation** `utils/wild/README.md:32` — The smoke command passes a directory to a file-only validator. Its output root also cannot satisfy datastore path checks. (inline)
- **RAV-RUN2-R1-F003 [medium] memory-use** `utils/wild/adapter.py:142` — Capped instance runs still materialize all selected columns for a complete row group before the cap is checked. (inline)
- **RAV-RUN2-R1-F004 [medium] data-validation** `utils/wild/adapter.py:157` — Missing scores become incorrect answers and stay in aggregate denominators. Missing token data becomes measured zero instead of being omitted. (inline)
- **RAV-RUN2-R1-F005 [medium] metric-identity** `utils/wild/adapter.py:210` — Each task receives a different metric ID even though every result is canonical accuracy. Cross-source joins by metric ID become fragmented. (inline)
- **RAV-RUN2-R1-F006 [medium] instance-linkage** `utils/wild/adapter.py:367` — Multi-subtask rows contribute to overall and leaf results, but instances link only to leaves. This conflicts with the one-record-per-contributing-result guidance. (earlier comment remains open)
